tasks.short: Arrange funeral details with families and friends.

steps.what: Consult family about actual service wishes, casket selection and obituary facts
inputs: actual family wishes, verified deceased details and available funeral options
outputs: manager-captured actual wishes, selected options and verified obituary facts

steps.what: Populate arrangement sheet from captured case fields using native funeral case templates
inputs: manager-captured actual wishes, selected options and verified obituary facts

steps.what: Draft obituary wording from verified family facts and stated tone
inputs: manager-captured actual wishes, selected options and verified obituary facts

loop.purpose: Propose variable obituary wording faithful to actual family choices
loop.input: Verified family facts and explicitly selected tone
loop.output: Draft wording with each factual sentence tied to a captured fact
loop.check: Manager checks complete meaning, names, omissions, tone and every factual implication against actual wishes; no invented relationships or life events
loop.stop: Missing facts or two failed corrections return wording to manual composition
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed fields prepare the arrangement sheet; variable family-approved obituary prose needs language drafting

steps.what: Finalize with family and approve complete arrangement sheet, obituary wording and copy recipient
inputs: draft exact funeral arrangement sheet
manager-checked draft obituary wording
actual family corrections and confirmation
outputs: approved complete final arrangement copy and exact family recipient

steps.what: Save the approved complete final funeral arrangement version
inputs: approved complete final arrangement copy and exact family recipient

steps.what: Send approved complete final arrangement copy to the approved family recipient
inputs: approved complete final arrangement copy and exact family recipient

tasks.design: Use native {FUNERAL_CASE} arrangement templates first, then bounded wording assistance only for actual obituary prose. The manager captures facts during actual consultation, checks all draft meaning and finalizes the complete version with the family. Separate save and family-copy dispatch follow final-version approval. This prepares wording; it does not silently publish an obituary or book services.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated arrangement-field copying and first wording from actual wishes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case templates plus source-bound prose drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Bereavement, differing family wishes and accurate personal details.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing what matters to the family and choosing humane wording.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly around unchanged family consultation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: funeral case fields can populate arrangement templates and bounded language tools can propose prose; actual suitability must be checked.

assumptions: Shares and reductions are provisional. Count only residual field copying and wording after current case tools; existing native rendering earns no new saving.

s1 counts actual capture of case_id, deceased_name, family facts, casket option, service choices and tone. Missing facts remain manual. s3 retains 9 hours of substantive meaning and tone checking; s4 fully counts final family corrections and confirmation.

Approval occurs after the complete final actual copy and exact recipient exist; any changed wording or recipient voids approval. Same-system save and actual send remain full effort. No actual family agreement is inferred from a draft.
research_questions: Which repeated arrangement copying and first wording remain after native templates?

incremental.description: Maintain arrangement field maps and review obituary draft fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final arrangement version including obituary wording
s4 complete final arrangement copy and exact family recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 exact-template benefit plus 15 times 40% prose benefit = 21 less 2 upkeep = 19. Low keeps prose manual and halves template benefit: 7.5 less 2 = 5.5; provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check actual family timing, facility availability and required service dependencies in native calendar views
inputs: actual family timing wishes and current facility availability records

inputs: checked feasible service slot options
actual family and facility responses
outputs: manager-confirmed selected service slot and requirements

steps.what: Prepare exact service booking fields from verified funeral case and selected slot
inputs: manager-confirmed selected service slot and requirements
actual verified funeral case fields

steps.what: Verify and approve complete final service booking and exact facility destination
inputs: draft exact service booking
manager-confirmed selected service slot and requirements
outputs: approved complete final booking and exact facility destination

steps.what: Submit approved complete final booking to approved facility
inputs: approved complete final booking and exact facility destination

steps.what: Check actual facility acceptance and approve complete final family confirmation
inputs: actual facility booking response
outputs: approved final actual booking confirmation and exact family recipient

steps.what: Send approved actual booking confirmation to approved family recipient
inputs: approved final actual booking confirmation and exact family recipient

tasks.design: Configure native availability views and case-to-booking templates in {FUNERAL_CASE}. Actual family and facility coordination remain full work. Verify the complete final booking before its separate facility submission. Inspect the actual acceptance before drafting and approving the separate family confirmation. No requested slot is represented as accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated slot-context checking and recopying verified case fields into a booking draft.
tasks.enabler_now: Native availability views and case-linked booking templates.
tasks.still_hard: Actual facility constraints, family timing and rejected or changed slots.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving conflicts sensitively under real time constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less scheduling preparation with actual coordination retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: booking systems can show facility availability and populate draft booking fields; funeral-specific integration requires verification.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, conditional on residual slot checking and draft rekeying after native tools. Existing booking generation or runtime earns no benefit.

Existing case capture and retained s1/s2 checks supply case_id, deceased identity, service_type, facility_id, selected_slot and actual requirements. Availability comes from actual facility records; missing or stale data requires manual confirmation. s1 retains 15 hours and s4 retains full checking.

Approvals follow complete final booking and, later, actual acceptance-based final confirmation. Changes void approvals. Submission and confirmation send retain full effort; share 1 is schema granularity, not measured click cost. Rejections return to full human coordination.

Actual signature status is observed before its final record is approved and separately saved.

tasks.still_hard: Authorized signature, actual certificate accuracy and physical delivery requirements.

Actual certificate issuer and verified office records supply case_id, certificate_version and authorized_contact. s1 retains 5 hours for freshness and source checks; missing authority or contact details require manual verification.

tasks.short: Offer counsel and comfort to bereaved families and friends.

steps.what: Check existing family case context using the already configured native case view
inputs: actual existing family case context

steps.what: Listen and offer actual counsel and comfort to bereaved family or friends
inputs: checked current family context
actual bereaved person needs and responses
outputs: actual supportive conversation and expressed support needs

steps.what: Write minimal actual support follow-up note and approve its complete final version
inputs: actual supportive conversation and expressed support needs
outputs: approved final minimal actual support follow-up note

steps.what: Save approved final actual support follow-up note
inputs: approved final minimal actual support follow-up note

tasks.design: Retain personal counsel and comfort. Split and inspect the case lookup, actual support note and separate save. Under the stated scenario the native case view and direct minimal-note template are already configured, so no residual rekeying or duplicate note is removed. A new transcription or drafting tool adds capture and checking without an established net reduction.
tasks.previous_blocker: No remaining record-transfer problem is established after the existing case view and direct-note template.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native case and minimal-note tools already cover the supporting records.
tasks.still_hard: Actual grief, trust and knowing how to respond sensitively.
tasks.altitude: Personal bereavement support with unchanged minimal records.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case views and direct note templates can already support this work; the existing setup is an explicit scenario assumption.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. Zero follows separate review of lookup, actual note writing and save, rather than excluding them from conversation.

The existing native view and direct-note template are assumed configured. Actual listening and selective factual note capture still require full manager effort; no free transcript or structured summary is supplied.

If actual duplicated note entry or manual reference retrieval is found, reassess those explicit steps. Existing runtime and same-system save earn no new benefit. The complete final actual note exists before approval and separate save; minimum share is schema granularity.
